data.title: Oceana at Aida
data.about:
Welcome to Oceana at Aida, where you can experience luxury living amidst breathtakingly natural surroundings. Our exclusive oceanfront mansions offer 3-bedroom villas to 6–7-bedroom luxurious mansions with a 70/30 payment plan designed to provide you with the ultimate retreat.

Whether you’re seeking tranquillity or adventure, Oceana at Aida has something for everyone. Tee off at the world-renowned Trump International Golf Course, explore mountain bike trails, or simply take in the breathtaking views from our viewing deck.

characteristics_module.title: Literally, above and beyond
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• A 1.6 million square foot gated neighborhood
  • Located ontop a mountain with sea views

  • Access to the world-renowned trump international golf course
  •  Luxurious architecture with an unparallel finish

location_tile.title: A paradise perfectly located
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Oceana at Aida is a sanctuary that is conveniently located within 20 minutes from the center of Muscat. On the calm Muscat hilltops, Aida is a refuge of natural beauty, outdoor recreation, and luxurious living.

The Nikki Beach Resort offers residents unrivaled luxury, and a world of indulgence is only a short distance away. In addition to the stunning natural surroundings, this opulent gated community is well-situated to provide you with the best of both worlds.

  • Nikki Beach Resort and Spa- 1 minute away
  • Marina Sustainable City- 5 Minutes away
  • Muscat Bay – 7 Minutes away
  • Downtown – 20 Minutes away
  • Muscat International Airport – 25 Minutes away
